note:
Rouge — SR / Supporter / Electric / Burst I coin-state support (burst cd 20s). Board: 1.027 on 3 graded comps (0.96 / 1.05 / 1.07). All magnitudes are kit-literal (datamined level-10); no calibrated values. Kit-faithfulness is pinned test-first in scripts/tests/units/rouge.test.ts (17 pins), including an INERT proof that strips every Max-HP grant and moves zero damage.
HP-SCALING DETERMINATION = OFFENSIVELY INERT. Every 'Max HP ▲ X% of the skill user's Max HP' line is a casterMaxHpPct ALLY grant. Ally-granted Max HP does NOT feed a consumer's ATK-as-%-of-Max-HP conversion — that conversion counts the consumer's OWN Max HP only (MEASURED, cinderella e3 focus video; the rule is stated in docs/data/damage-calculation.md and enforced in the engine by effectiveAtk's casterIdx === self test). Rouge has no atkOfMaxHpPct line of her own, so even her self-grants feed nothing, and the engine has no HP pool — the grants move no damage. They are modeled anyway, as casterMaxHpPct effects, for kit-completeness.
OFFENSIVE — 3 load-bearing lines. (S1) burstCdr 7s to all allies every 8 Full Charges (hitCount 8; an SR lands 1 hit per charged pull). This is her biggest damage lever: it accelerates the whole team's rotation. (S2) Sword Coin Attack Damage ▲6.65% as a permanent passive on selfAndAdjacent sides:2 — 'self and 2 allies on both sides', so it is POSITIONAL and an edge-slotted rouge reaches only 3 of 5. (Burst) ATK ▲15.07% of caster ATK to all allies for 10s on her burstCast (casterAtkPct, flat-resolved).
COIN-STATE MACHINE (Sword → Shield at 30 Full Charges → Double Sword at 5 own bursts in Shield) is tracked as engine state: resource `coin` (0 = Sword, 1 = Shield, 2 = Double Sword) and resource `shieldBursts` (own bursts cast during Shield). Progression: hitCount:30 + resourceGate{coin,max:0} flips Sword → Shield and applies the Shield Coin Damage-Taken ▼15.2% line on the same fire; each burstCast under gate{coin == 1} counts a shield-era burst; gate{shieldBursts >= 5} flips Shield → Double Sword, post-increment (the maxwell precedent) so the 5th shield-era burst IS the first Double Sword cast. The three per-tier burst riders (Sword 10.15 / Shield 20.1 / Double Sword 30.02, casterMaxHpPct to allies, 10s) and the Double Sword continuous Max HP ▲15.08% are resourceGate'd on `coin` — exact gating, no approximation. Same-frame BLOCK ORDER is load-bearing here and nothing lints it: the shieldBursts increment must stay listed before the coin flip that reads it.
SHIELD COIN DAMAGE-TAKEN ▼15.2% IS INERT, and not only because it is defensive. It is encoded on an ALLY target, but damageTakenPct is a boss-side StatKey — the engine sums it from the enemy buff list only, so an ally-targeted one is applied and never read. Correct outcome, off-contract encoding: it reads as a live buff to anyone scanning this file. validate-overrides warns on the mismatch since 2026-08-10 (BOSS_ONLY_BUFF_STATS in src/skills/validate-structural.ts): the warning is expected — keep the line, never "fix" the target or the sign.
⚑ FLAGS (UNMEASURED). (1) COIN EXCLUSIVITY [measurement-gated, tier 2] — the kit prose is silent on whether upgrading Sword → Shield → Double Sword REPLACES the prior coin or COEXISTS. If Shield Coin REPLACES Sword Coin at ~30 Full Charges (~40-50s in), the team LOSES the 6.65% Attack Damage mid-fight (uptime ≈ the first quarter); the shipped model takes the 'continuously' wording as a permanent passive (full uptime). Recipe: focus video — does the 6.65% Attack Damage buff persist on rouge's adjacent allies after Shield Coin activates? (2) SHIELD-COIN BURST RIDER HEAL ASYMMETRY [coin-state-gated + measurement-gated, tier 2] — four of the five Max-HP lines say 'without restoring HP'; the Shield-Coin burst rider (Max HP ▲20.1%) ALONE omits that clause, so read literally it RESTORES HP and would emit a recovery event arming on-recovery consumers (crown's 'when recovery takes effect' team ATK buff). The coin gate is expressible now, but the heal itself is NOT modeled pending footage; the marginal impact is small, since crown's recovery consumer is typically already saturated by her own heals. Recipe: focus video with a recovery consumer — does rouge's burst proc crown's recovery buff once Shield Coin is up? (3) BACK-ROW CONDITION on S2 has no engine primitive and is modeled as an unconditional passive; rouge is an SR and is always back row, so the assumption holds at scope lock. Documented, not encoded.
RAMP: she carries no stack-ramp line — the coin tiers are discrete resource states, not a ramp, so there is no bake-at-cap approximation here to correct.
